objective: Compose normalized Telnyx correlation resolution, durable bridge application, and canonical attempt execution while preserving call-leg identity and bounded stale recovery.
orderingRules: Resolve call-leg correlation once at application entry.
Apply durable bridge state before canonical attempt reconciliation.
A bridge deferred outcome stops canonical attempt mutation and receipt consumption.
bridge-not-found and stale-bridge stop canonical attempt mutation.
Bridge no-op or updated outcomes permit canonical attempt reconciliation.
Canonical stale-attempt recovery rereads the canonical attempt exactly once, replans with the same call-leg correlation, and retries the attempt executor exactly once.
Attempt-only stale recovery must not rerun bridge application.
identityRules: The original resolved correlation and legRole remain authoritative through attempt retry.
A refreshed canonical attempt must retain the correlation attemptId.
Canonical providerReference may remain the operator call reference while lead-leg evidence is applied.
Provider-event receipt ownership remains with the correlated attempt executor.
unresolvedRules: correlation-not-found performs zero bridge and attempt writes.
orphaned-correlation performs zero bridge and attempt writes.
A refreshed canonical attempt that disappears returns attempt-not-found.
next: A later authorized runtime slice may bind this normalized-event application service to verified webhook ingress.
